import json, sys, time, resource, io
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/tmp/tests','/opt/emicro-deps','/workspace/project']
import driver
names=['S%02d'%i for i in range(16)]
reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
LIM={'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
jobs=[]
for j in range(4):
    events=[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(S00,S01) allow;'},{'op':'commit','epoch':1}]
    events.append({'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'S00'})
    events.append({'op':'open','connection':[1,1]})
    while len(events)<50000:
        events.append({'op':'send','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'destination':'S01'})
    jobs.append({'services':reg,'limits':LIM,'events':events})
data=json.dumps({'jobs':jobs},separators=(',',':')).encode()
print('input bytes',len(data), '%.1f MiB'%(len(data)/1048576))
t=time.time()
buf=io.BytesIO(); w=driver.Writer(buf,chunk=1<<21)
driver.run(data,w); w.flush()
print('run %.2fs out %d bytes'%(time.time()-t,buf.tell()))
print('peak rss MiB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
r=json.loads(buf.getvalue()[:2000].decode(errors='ignore')+'}}]}')if False else None
out=json.loads(buf.getvalue())
print('results',len(out['results']), out['results'][0]['events'][2], out['results'][0]['events'][4])
EOF
